chunks: And in the narration of Abān from Zurārah from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
He must pay a diyyah (blood money) and one-third.

key_terms.ثُلُثٌ: one-third; an additional proportional amount added to the compensation
key_terms.دِيَةٌ: blood money; financial compensation due for unlawful killing or injury

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about paying diyyah plus one-third?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a concise legal ruling concerning liability in diyyah. It states that the responsible party must pay the full blood money plus an additional one-third, indicating a specific quantified compensation in the law of injuries and retaliation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5213 - In the narration of Aban from Zurarah from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:
"He must pay the full blood money (diyyah) plus one-third."
